fusions.name: Palmed Coin
fusions.desc: Reaches an arm out that deals 32 damage and is always a critical hit, rising to 1.5 times that at the full 6 tiles.

fusions.name: Wrong Arm
fusions.desc: Strikes with one arm while another flings ink, dealing 10 damage, knocking the target back 2 tiles and leaving it [Blunted] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Shell and Switch
fusions.desc: Veils you for 6 seconds and raises your movement speed by 20% while it holds. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Count Short
fusions.desc: When your strikes go a while without a critical hit, your critical hit chance rises by 30% for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
